title: Mediator Pattern
overview: Define an object that encapsulates how a set of objects interact, reducing direct dependencies between them.
useCases: Many objects communicate with each other, creating complex dependencies
You want to reduce coupling between objects
You want to keep coordination logic in one place instead of spreading it across many classes
exampleUses: An air traffic control tower that coordinates all aircraft landings and take-offs so planes never communicate directly with each other
A chat room server that relays messages between users so no user holds references to any other user directly
A GUI dialog where enabling a checkbox should enable a text field and disable a button — a mediator owns this logic instead of the widgets knowing about each other
